name: oguri
description: Git-backed coordination between AI coding agents. Bundles the oguri MCP server (17 tools, 4 resources), connection-time agent self-description, a SessionStart hook that surfaces the inbox that accumulated while no agent was running, seven skills covering first contact / inbox triage / human handoff / messaging / collaborative tasks / repository review / setup, a `/oguri:handshake` command that greets another machine's agent and watches for the reply without blocking, and a read-only `reviewer` subagent for delegated cross-repository reviews. Requires the `oguri` CLI on PATH.
